newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel issues 550 mln-pesos papers.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel issues 550 mln-pesos papers.

text.p: Food and beer conglomerate San Miguel Corp has raised 550 million pesos from the issue of long-term commercial papers (LTCPs), lead underwriter All Asia Capital and Trust Corp said in a statement on Tuesday.
SMC will use the proceeds to finance various phases of its modernisation programmes as well as its existing operations, All Asia said.
The latest papers issued by the SMC are part of the 3.0 billion pesos worth of LTCPs which it was allowed to float by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
All Asia said the LTCPS carried a six-year repayment term and an interest rate of 0.75 percentage point over the average 91-day Treasury bill rate.
